meta.about: Simulacrum (simulacrumai.io) turns a résumé into a running wealth engine — a career-to-wealth simulation platform with 49 AI agents across five income layers. We help professionals see the consequences of their career and money decisions before they live them.
meta.shared_note: Every teammate is fully platform-fluent — able to demo Simulacrum, onboard a user end to end, run a workshop, and coach Layer 1 and Layer 2 agent setup — so anyone can cover a session or a coaching block.
meta.team_goal: 1,000 users, with 35% paying for one to two simulations.

jobs.title: Growth & Marketing Lead
jobs.tagline: Fill the top of the funnel — get the right professionals to sign up, repeatably and measurably.
jobs.owns: New free signups per week by channel · content, SEO & LinkedIn distribution · landing pages & signup flow · the free bio-page as lead magnet · paid-acquisition experiments after organic proof.
responsibilities: Build and run the content, SEO and LinkedIn engine that drives free signups from professionals and career-changers.
Own the landing pages and signup flow; A/B test messaging and conversion.
Position the free bio page as the lead magnet and on-ramp into the platform.
Launch paid-acquisition experiments once a channel proves out organically, and hold CAC discipline.
Track signups by source and report weekly on what is actually working.
Hand activation-ready users cleanly to the Onboarding lead.
jobs.north_star: New free signups per week — the engine behind reaching 1,000 users.
jobs.supporting_metrics: Cost per signup · channel mix · signup-to-activation handoff rate.
looking_for: 3+ years in growth, demand generation or content marketing — ideally B2C / prosumer SaaS.
Demonstrated organic growth (content, SEO, LinkedIn) with real numbers behind it.
Fluent in funnel analytics and rapid experimentation.
Strong writer who can produce problem-aware content for a professional audience.
Working knowledge of paid acquisition (LinkedIn / Meta / Google) and CAC math.
jobs.nice_to_have: An audience in career, HR or edtech; landing-page design skills.

jobs.title: Partnerships & Corporate Sales Lead
jobs.tagline: Land corporate clients and cohort partners who bring users in batches — the fastest route to 1,000 users and bulk paying seats.
jobs.owns: The corporate / enterprise pipeline · education-cohort deals · workshop sponsors · all B2B proposals, pricing and closes.
responsibilities: Build and close a pipeline of corporate clients (outplacement, L&D, career-mobility) and education partners running cohorts and workshops.
Recruit and activate referral / advisor partners who each bring a cohort of users with them.
Secure workshop sponsors to cover materials, token costs, refreshments and volunteers.
Own B2B proposals, pricing conversations and contracts; land bulk and enterprise seat deals.
Represent Simulacrum to boards, directors and institutional buyers.
Feed signed corporate cohorts to the Onboarding lead for delivery.
jobs.north_star: Users acquired via partners and cohorts, plus signed corporate deals.
jobs.supporting_metrics: Active partners · pipeline value · seats sold.
looking_for: 4+ years in B2B sales, partnerships or business development — ideally SaaS, HR-tech, edtech or workforce.
Track record closing institutional / enterprise deals and running a pipeline.
Relationship-led seller who is comfortable with executives and boards.
Able to structure cohort, sponsor and enterprise offers and negotiate contracts.
A Bay Area network across tech, education or workforce development.
jobs.nice_to_have: Existing relationships with universities, workforce boards or corporate L&D.

jobs.title: Onboarding & Workshop Lead
jobs.tagline: Turn a signup into an activated user who completes their first setup — and run the live workshops that make it happen at scale.
jobs.owns: Customer ingestion (account, résumé upload, expertise-zone recognition, bio-page publish) · live workshop sessions · the onboarding sequence.
responsibilities: Run group onboarding and live workshop sessions for both individual users and corporate cohorts.
Guide customer ingestion: account setup, résumé upload, expertise-zone review and bio-page publish.
Build and maintain the onboarding sequence and quick-start materials.
Drive activation — get each user to their first completed simulation fast.
Design cohort-based delivery so a team of four can serve 1,000 users (group over 1:1).
Hand activated users to the Coaching lead for agent setup and conversion.
jobs.north_star: Activation rate — the share of signups who reach their first simulation.
jobs.supporting_metrics: Workshop completion rate · time-to-activation · session NPS.
looking_for: 3+ years in onboarding, customer education, training, facilitation or teaching.
An excellent live facilitator who can run a room and keep a cohort moving.
Builds repeatable onboarding processes and materials, not one-offs.
Patient, clear communicator, at ease with non-technical users.
Organized enough to run recurring cohorts on a schedule.
jobs.nice_to_have: Instructional design; experience in career services or adult education.

jobs.title: Coaching & Agent Enablement Lead
jobs.tagline: Get users to a visible result so they pay — and come back for a second simulation. Coach Layer 1 and Layer 2 agent setup until it produces outcomes.
jobs.owns: Coaching Layer 1 (Active Income) & Layer 2 (Leveraged Income) agent setup · contact / CRM setup · the first simulation · free-to-paid conversion · the second-simulation nudge.
responsibilities: Coach users to configure Layer 1 agents (rate card, outreach, booking) and Layer 2 agents (group coaching, workshops, waitlist) with realistic parameters.
Set up each customer's contacts / CRM and run their first simulation to a visible result.
Own the free-to-paid conversation and convert engaged free users to a $167 simulation.
Drive expansion — the second simulation on a second expertise zone.
Turn the Playbook's parameter sheets into hands-on coaching.
Feed conversion and coaching insight back to Growth and Product.
jobs.north_star: Free-to-paid conversion (the 35% / 350 payers) and simulations per payer (the 1 → 2).
looking_for: 3+ years in customer success, coaching, consulting or high-touch sales.
A consultative closer who converts by delivering value, not pressure.
Fast to master a technical product and coach others to configure it.
Comfortable with numbers and parameters (rates, funnels) — can help users pick realistic inputs.
Empathy for career-changers paired with drive for a conversion target.
jobs.nice_to_have: Familiarity with freelancing / consulting economics and CRM tools.
